comment.body: Thanks for confirming this involves two Windows 11 Pro PCs and giving the key/name pairing sequence. The report does not say whether either PC sees the other after setup. Could you confirm whether this still fails on latest stable on both PCs and what connection status each MWB window shows immediately after pairing? If it still fails, add `/bugreport` on both PCs immediately after one attempt and include the approximate time. This distinguishes pairing/discovery from the later network handshake.
